name: Phong specular lobes vs the analytic value: RGB lights, three Phong spheres on a Phong plane
description: Three white Phong spheres (exponents 60, 200, 12) on a Phong plane (exponent 20) under a red, a green and a blue point light (normalised modified Phong: kd/pi + ks (n+2)/(2 pi) cos^n alpha). pbrt-v4 has no Phong BRDF, so the reference is the closed form with hard shadows, box-filtered over each pixel. Pixels at the highlight peaks and in the coloured shadows.

pixels.label: plane, lit by all three lights (white)
